entries.speaker: Melancholic Female Student
entries.en: I feel so down when it's raining.[n]I guess we're playing volleyball[n]in the gym for PE today.

entries.speaker: Loud Female Student
entries.en: I am not looking forward to that.[n]Why'd I have to be on the same[n]team as Takamaki?

entries.speaker: Loud Female Student
entries.en: I feel so awkward around her... Isn't she[n]too busy being a famous supermodel[n]to come to high school?

entries.speaker: Melancholic Female Student
entries.en: That's what I would've figured—but we[n]can't just blow her off, either. You know,[n]the whole Kamoshida thing...

entries.speaker: Loud Female Student
entries.en: Dealing with her is such a hassle.[n]I wish she'd just not come to school.
